scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); fs.readdirSync('www').forEach(f=>{if(f.endsWith('.apk')||f.endsWith('.zip')) fs.unlinkSync('www/'+f);}); fs.readdirSync('.').forEach(f=>{if(['.html','.js','.css','.png','.jpg','.svg'].some(ext=>f.endsWith(ext))) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/'+f);}); console.log('Assets copied to www');"
